note: Every invariant this repo asserts, with its current status. Entries are NEVER removed or weakened; a test that stops being true is a bug in the code or a DECISIONS.md entry, not a deletion.

invariants.statement: main has a pushed commit; the four bootstrap files are tracked; .gitignore ignores and whitelists correctly
project.pbxproj carries zero inline build settings
the generated Info.plist is iPhone-only, portrait-only, declares export compliance, resolves the bundle id and carries the wordmark
the eight tags are declared, pairwise distinct, and the two axes are disjoint
HunchTestSupport is absent from products and from every non-test target's dependencies
isApproximatelyEqual handles infinities, NaN, signed zero, absolute and relative tolerance
SplitMix64 reproduces the published reference vectors for seed 0
mix(0) == 0, which is why next() adds the gamma before finalising
Corpora.seed(band:index:) derivation is frozen against recorded vectors
each of checks 1,2,3,4,5,6,9,10 catches a planted violation, and the legal spellings (.random(using:), TOKENS-EXEMPT) are not flagged
invariants.command: see the probe block in E01/T06

invariants.statement: no network API appears in any Swift source; enforced at build time and in CI
the hygiene build phase runs with ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING=YES and zero deny(1) lines
swift test --package-path HunchCore completes in under 10 seconds
the Presubmission plan selects a non-zero number of tests
RGB8.relativeLuminance is WCAG 2.1 sRGB with the 0.04045 knee and 2.4 exponent; contrastRatio is symmetric and closed on 1.0…21.0
the four hues are Okabe-Ito byte-identical in dark AND light; they are never re-lit
the four measured corrections to §13.2 hold: amber 8.79, teal 5.78, teal-rose 1.12, amber-brass 1.22
weight resolution is Select→Scale→Offset→Derive: Bold Text + High Contrast on .body is 4.25, not 4.375; the ladder stays strictly increasing and pairwise distinct
the light keyline (+1.0) and the halo (x3) are derived from the already-resolved weight and are never themselves scaled or offset
every state-bearing token clears 4.5:1 on its own ground in all three themes; stroke.hairline is deliberately below it and never state-bearing
the raw Okabe-Ito hues do NOT clear 3:1 on the light ground, which is why the keyline exists; the keyline itself clears 15:1
the High Contrast state-bearing set clears its measured 9.68 floor and each of the four ratios is pinned individually
the glyph frame is screen-space y-down: bodyCentre -0.10*S, indexCentre +0.43*S, both negated from §13.5's y-up statement
the fill ink-coverage ladder is 0/22.7/38.6/100 % at every size, derived from the pitch tokens rather than asserted
T = 8.00 pt^2, the measured minimum pairwise ink difference over all 32,640 deck pairs at S=44 @2x
every pair in the deck separates by geometry alone in all six render environments; tightest margin is High Contrast + Bold Text at 12 %
each of the seven shared marks has exactly one owning function; the machined bar and the tick row are drawn from one place, not from each of their seven sites
the verdict is ring direction and closure, never colour; the twin split ring and the counterexample's distinct dash patterns survive greyscale
the DEBUG snapshot gallery renders every mark x state x three themes plus greyscale and Bold Text, as the visual-regression corpus
Subset4 rejects the empty and full masks; Contextual fixes cur on the leading side; there is no NOT case
all eight of §5.2's exemplar laws reproduce their published p and the five §5.1 metrics, including band 8 COUNT at deficit .286
§5.5's 15-probe band-5 round and §5.6's band-3 round reproduce verdict for verdict under previously-PROBED semantics
RNF gives one law one layout, and does NOT merge a same-attribute Bridge pair even though its extension would
attribute liveness permutes cur and prev independently, so RANK a(cur) == PREV RANK a keeps its attribute live
§5.4's ceil(k*log2|H| + d) reproduces §5.7's locked par row for all eight bands
the six stateless bands enumerate to §5.2's counts exactly (40/1272/108/2322/5688/337) and the lower-band index totals 9,767
all eight of §5.2's published δ values reproduce within 0.001, and each lands inside its own band's range
generate() is pure over its five arguments plus an explicitly threaded LawIndex; sampling is integer-only and unbiased
the anchor fallback rate stays under 2 % per band once the target is clamped into achievableDifficultyRange
§6.9's three worked rounds reproduce; the gradient is flat below par; the middle mark threshold does not move
§4.5's four selection steps hold, including a false negative winning over a strictly nearer false positive
10,000 laws per band across six stateless bands satisfy every invariant the brief names: valid, RNF, satisfiable, falsifiable, in-window, in-band, not secretly easier, one node per extension
a 192-row golden recorded in one process reproduces byte-identically in a separate process; the law index order is stable across builds
§11.13's ten file kinds, twenty paths derived from Band and Mode, each with a stated recovery policy
save then drop the actor then open a NEW store over the same directory keeps the bytes
a commit that fails partway leaves the round slot intact and resumable; a clean commit clears it last
the snapshot stores the resolved law and recomputes verdicts, so a tampered probe list cannot forge a verdict and a swapped law fails the integrity check
the hand-written Fixtures/v1 tree still loads, and is never regenerated to make a build pass
all five resets leave anomaly.json and anomaly.hw byte-identical — the whole anti-cheat
clearing the Codex does not drop the palette ceiling; only resetting the ladder does

§6.6's five discoverability layers are present, and identical, in every one of the eight bands — a layer that appeared only where the law is contextual would announce the family it exists to make findable

tickPitch = min(nominalPitch, rowWidth/N) and never clamps inside PROBE, so the par row's LENGTH stays proportional to par — §5.4's only difficulty signal; Dynamic Type scales tick heights and never the pitch
the spool sheet's 70 cells are at least 1 + the largest cap over every Mode x Band, so the longest possible round in any mode fits one screen with no scrolling
invariants.command: swift test --package-path Modules --filter SpoolSheetTests && swift test --package-path HunchCore --filter RoundBudgetTests

invariants.statement: the 260 ms adjudication hold is constant across verdict, band and contextuality and in both motion modes — variable latency is a side channel that would leak the family before probe 3
RoundPhase.advance is the only writer of a phase; every row of §6.1's table holds and every other (phase, event) pair is refused rather than trapped
every one of §6.11's 29 rows is accounted for exactly once — a named passing test, or a named row in the delegation table with its owning epic; the two sets are disjoint and their union is 1…29
the opening round's cap cannot end the round while no reject has landed; the first reject re-arms it at max(Band.literal.cap, probesUsed+3); the suspension hard-stops at probe 24
a nudge can name a control and nothing else — the target type has no payload — and VoiceOver suppresses every nudge at the scheduler without spending a budget

a declaration is judged by extension identity in the common space with lifting, so a differently-spelled equivalent is correct and a stateless declaration against a contextual law is lifted before comparison
the live Assay is the pair table's row for the pinned prev, never the unconditional marginal projection, and it is fed by the player's draft and never by the hidden law
invariants.command: swift test --package-path HunchCore --filter AssayTests && swift test --package-path Modules --filter AssayWiringTests

invariants.statement: the Level-A harness realises 0.80 ± 0.03 across the servable ability range with the real policy and the real estimator; the floor and the ceiling are censored and are named tests rather than excluded cases
the ability estimator is strictly symmetric, reproduces §10.2's published K row, and is unbiased at its own fixed point under sampled outcomes
targetδ lies inside the band it was served for at every point of the state space, including after the family-repeat guard and the ceiling rotation have moved the band
D1, D2 and D4 hold on a law pair: distinct, disagreement rate in [0.10,0.30], and at least 8 broken positives — the directional guardrail a disagreement rate cannot see
§7.7's par_DRIFT/cap_DRIFT/forced-hinge table reproduces row for row, bands 1-2 have no rows at all, and the forced hinge is measured against par rather than par_DRIFT
ECHO's primer eliminates on screen progressively and monotonically, and the cast cannot begin while more than one pool member is lit
at most one glyph is ever actionable, at every band and every tempo step — pitch 132 against a gate of 88, so the rate cancels
SIEVE's ratio is normalised over resolved glyphs so accuracy and reach are charged exactly once each; the squared alternative is computed in the test and is 3.5x harsher
every Anomaly parameter is a pure function of the UTC day index; the band reads the low bits and the high-bit spelling disagrees on more than 300 of 500 days
radii normalise against the player's own five-axis mean, so improving on every axis draws the identical silhouette; idling decays confidence and never the value
every reachable screen is within two taps of a live probe surface, and a suspended round opens at zero
not one of the five destructive settings rows touches the Anomaly ledger, and clearing the Codex and resetting the ladder are genuinely separable
every LocKey has a catalog entry and every entry has a key; the catalog stays inside its 250-key budget; no entry is a wordmark and no string names a Profile axis
Localizable.xcstrings carries all twelve shipping locales for all 104 keys
invariants.command: bash Scripts/check-source-hygiene.sh  # check 8's locale-set and per-key arms
invariants.note: OPEN AND OWNED, not a regression — which is what this status is for. The English source is complete and commented; the eleven other locales are not written. §12.9's process has a native speaker flip each entry from needsReview to translated, and no machine draft was authored here: marking untrusted output as reviewed, in a repo with no reviewer, is theatre that would show as green. Check 8's budget and duplicate-comment arms run today; its locale-set and per-key-completeness arms engage the moment a second locale appears, so the gate re-arms itself rather than needing to be remembered.
